newsitem.title: POLAND: ING-Barings rates Polish 3-month T-bills as buy.
newsitem.headline: ING-Barings rates Polish 3-month T-bills as buy.

text.p: ING-Baring recommended as a buy Polish three-month T-bills or three month delivery forewards in its Fixed-Income Strategy Quarterly View and Asset Allocation Emerging Markets Research dated April 1997.
The report said the zloty should not weaken despite a growing current account deficit as the trade gap would be more than offset by direct foreign investment.

"With the zloty basket expected to remain within a two to three percent range below central parity, short-dated assets with yields around 22 percent offer the best prospects on a risk-reward basis," ING-Baring said.
At Monday's tender the average yield of the 13-week T-bill fell to 21.00 percent from last week's 21.30.
The report also said year-on-year inflation should fall to around 15 percent at the end of 1997 from March's 16.6 percent.
